CALNEW LITERATURE: PAPERS AND MAILS
Scope: 750 papers on aroma molecules and olfaction; 750 papers on molecule-level AI for pharmacology.
Potency note: ODT/OT, OAV/rOAV, GC–MS/O aroma-intensity ratings, relative concentrations, predicted receptor-docking scores, and mouse behavioral preference indices are distinct endpoints. Concentration and intensity readings are labeled separately from potency; literature thresholds and model predictions are identified. OAV depends on sample concentration, and a single-dose PI is not concentration-response potency. Class-level trends are not assigned to individual molecules.
Cross-paper potency annotations are exact canonical isomeric-SMILES matches cited to another saved article; source assays, samples, and prediction status remain explicit.
Each record includes an article source, stable identifiers, a seven-word description, publicly verifiable corresponding-author e-mail(s), and source-linked isomeric SMILES where uniquely resolved.
Paper type counts: 528 original research; 972 original methods.
Preprints: none in this journal-publication set; preprint and journal versions are not double-counted.
Email addresses are taken from Europe PMC or NCBI PMC full-text corresponding-author fields or notes. "not found" means no public corresponding-author address was located.
Molecules are drawn from article text and indexed supplementary annotations; publisher supplements were additionally checked where noted, and inaccessible sources are flagged.
Potency values are transcribed from each paper or its supplements; author-measured, literature-curated, and model-predicted values are labeled separately with their source table or section.
For structures, exact ChEBI/PubChem/NIH-CADD matches and OPSIN resolution of listed IUPAC names were used; unresolved source names and CAS entries remain unguessed.
